description: c115 physics-collision pillar coverage: boot to STAGE_CITRAINING via --skip-intro, then arm --debug-spawn-at (fc9645a one-shot latch) to teleport player 0 to the canonical CITRAINING spawn (637.0, 360.0, 923.0, room 16) once setupCreateProps has placed the player prop. The teleport calls chrMoveToPos with force=true so the capsule pipeline + chr tick keep running across the teleport. Test proves: (1) the new --debug-spawn-at flag parses + arms, (2) bootDebugSpawnAtTick consumes the latch (lvframenum >= 4, players[0]->prop->chr valid) and emits the consumed line with result=OK, (3) the capsule sweep + chr tick pipeline continues running for >=30 frames post-teleport without crashing or emitting collision-error log channels. Spawn position lifted from a prior CITRAINING boot log (.claude/smoke-verify-runs/20260514T031147Z-mission_intro_flow/pd-client.log line 992: 'SPAWN: pre-ground pos=(637.0,360.0,923.0) room=16 angle=1.570'). NOT trying to assert wall-jump or specific capsule behavior -- that is the wall_jump_capsule_smoke sibling test. This test is the harness-flag baseline that proves --debug-spawn-at works end-to-end before relying on it for richer physics scenarios. --no-net bakes in to close the firewall focus-steal class.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --skip-intro routes to STAGE_CITRAINING (0x26). --debug-spawn-at parses (637.0,360.0,923.0,16) into g_BootSpawnAt* latch globals and emits 'BOOT: --debug-spawn-at armed' before mainProc.

settle past setupCreateProps (~6s post-boot) so bootDebugSpawnAtTick's gates (lvframenum >= 4 AND players[0]->prop->chr alive) pass and chrMoveToPos fires. The consumed line should fire within ~7s of boot.

settle for >=30 frames of player tick post-teleport (lvframe60 < 30 window fires bgunTickGameplay 30 times unconditionally; that span proves the capsule + chr pipeline continued running past the teleport without crashing).
extra settle for BMOVE periodic logs (every 120 frames = ~2s) so we land 4+ BMOVE samples post-spawn-at consumption.
scripted exit -- by 55s the capsule + chr tick pipeline has had ~50s of post-teleport ticks; if anything was going to AV / collision-fault from the teleport, it would have surfaced.

required_lines: LOAD: lv\.c entering stage load sequence for stagenum=0x26
BOOT: --debug-spawn-at consumed: prop=(?:0x)?[0-9a-fA-F]+ stagenum=0x26 result=OK pos=\(637\.\d+,360\.\d+,923\.\d+\) room=16

required_counts.comment: bgunTickGameplay enter player=0 fires unconditionally on the first 30 ticks of the match (bondgun.c:12609 -- lvframe60 < 30 || lvframenum % 120 == 7). The --debug-spawn-at teleport fires at lvframenum >= 4, so the first 30 ticks are entirely post-arm and the bulk are post-consumption. Hitting >=30 of these proves the chr tick + bgun tick + (transitively) capsule sweep pipeline kept running for at least 30 frames after the teleport without crashing. Extra fires every 120 frames push the actual count to ~35+ in a 55s run.

BMOVE fires every 120 frames of lvframenum (~2s @ 60fps when not in cutscene). Hitting >=2 samples proves the bondmove tick ran past the initial boot frame and continued surviving downstream of the chr teleport. Conservative floor: CITRAINING's intro cutscene throttles lvframenum increments, so even healthy runs see only ~3 BMOVE in 55s; the bgunTickGameplay >=30 assertion above carries the heavier 'tick alive for 30+ frames' load.
